spanish: El sacerdote el pecante a ella la comerá; en lugar santo será comida, en atrio de tienda de reunión.

findings.issue: The definite piel participle governs the 3fs object. “el pecante” turns it into a second noun, “sinner,” and does not apply that participle to “ella”; “a ella la” only marks the object of “comerá.”
findings.spanishSpan: el pecante a ella la comerá

findings.issue: בַּ marks a definite court; “en atrio” leaves it unmarked.

notes: Priest, eat-her, indefinite holy place, feminine niphal, and tent of meeting otherwise match the tokens.
